title: Catalogue
subtitle: Browse vehicle variants — vehicle kind, brand, model, trim. Live from the provider, one page at a time.

mode.label: Mode
mode.tooltip: New shows only in-production ranges; used shows everything.

labelsLoadError.title: Labels unavailable
labelsLoadError.body: The labels for the catalogue's values could not be loaded. Values marked ⚠ show their code instead.

unavailable.title: auto-i-dat not reachable
unavailable.body: The provider is not answering right now. Try again later; identification of known vehicles keeps working.

loadError: The catalogue could not be loaded.

emptyState.title: No variants
emptyState.description: The provider lists no variant for this selection.

needsBrand.title: Choose a brand
needsBrand.description: Choose a vehicle kind and a brand — the catalogue is asked live from the provider, one page at a time.

notConfigured.title: No auto-i-dat access
notConfigured.body: This business has no active auto-i-dat connection. A vehicle is entered manually; the access is set up under Integrations.

notInContract.title: Catalogue not in the contract
notInContract.body: auto-i-dat refuses the catalogue query: the «ident_basis» option is not licensed for this access.
